result.reason: The mutual cap amount is substantially aligned with the preferred position, but the supplied operative language does not define “Excluded Claims” or expressly include the required carve-outs; the margin comment cannot supply those terms. It also omits the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and the clarification that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Accordingly, the redline does not demonstrably reach even the fallback carve-out position. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the clause’s liability-allocation intent, though “total aggregate” is redundant and the lookback runs from the event rather than the claim.
